description: Cykelvägar inkl blandtrafik is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Umeå kommun. Streets and parks for the bicycle map. The data set shows the cycling road network in the city centre and in the municipal districts. In the city centre, the pedestrian and bicycle road network is divided into main road networks and a local road network. Coverage: Umeå kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle paths incl. mixed traffic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Umeå kommun. Its keywords include Umeå kommun, Cykelväg, Cykel, Cykelstråk, Cykla. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GPX+XML, JSON, RDF_TURTLE, KML. The listing shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.sv). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
